name: get3w-server
description: Filesystem-backed API for Get3W remote clients

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @get3w/computer-use build && pnpm --filter @get3w/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun build src/opencode-v2-context-bridge.ts --external bun:sqlite --external drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite --outfile dist/opencode-v2-context-bridge.js --target node --format esm && bun build src/opencode-plugins/task-log-evidence-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-chrome-devtools.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-computer-use.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-extensions-preview.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-capabilities-knowledge.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-office-attachments.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-spreadsheets.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-pdf-attachments.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-anthropic-adaptive-thinking.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-anthropic-tool-schema.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-title-recovery.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-gateway-quota.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-gateway-quota-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-provider-filters-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-mcp-results-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-mcp-readiness-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-background-shell-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-visible-reasoning-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-auto-route-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-context-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/get3w-agent-permissions-v2.ts --external effect --root src/opencode-plugins --outdir dist/opencode-plugins --target node --format esm && node scripts/copy-pdfium-wasm.mjs dist/opencode-plugins
scripts.build:bin: pnpm --filter @get3w/computer-use build && pnpm --filter @get3w/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun build --compile src/cli.ts --outfile dist/bin/get3w-server
scripts.build:bin:all: pnpm --filter @get3w/computer-use build && pnpm --filter @get3w/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun ./script/build.ts --outdir dist/bin --target bun-darwin-arm64 --target bun-darwin-x64 --target bun-linux-x64 --target bun-linux-arm64 --target bun-windows-x64 --target bun-windows-arm64
scripts.build:npm-bundle: pnpm --filter @get3w/computer-use build && pnpm --filter @get3w/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun build src/cli.ts --target node --format esm --external bun:sqlite --external drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite --external jsonc-parser --outfile dist/npm-bundle/get3w-server.mjs
scripts.test:readiness: bun test test/opencode-stop-fence.test.ts test/opencode-v2-mcp-readiness.test.ts test/get3w-mcp-results-v2.test.ts test/get3w-session-groups.test.ts test/get3w-session-questions.test.ts test/get3w-affordance-args.test.ts test/personal-extension-discovery.test.ts test/personal-cloud-credentials.test.ts test/opencode-v2-instructions.test.ts test/opencode-v2-tool-schemas.test.ts test/get3w-context-computer-gate-v2.test.ts test/engine-v2-mcp-mapping.test.ts test/engine-v2-mcp-reconciliation.test.ts
